mn124:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Bakkulo Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
mn124:2.1: Atha kho Acela-Kassapo āyasmato Bakkulassa purāṇagihīsahāyo yen' āyasmā Bakkulo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Bakkulena saddhiṃ sammodi
mn124:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Acela-Kassapo āyasmantaṃ Bakkulaṃ etad avoca:
mn124:3.3: Imehi pana te, āvuso Bakkula, asītiyā vasehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevito ti?
mn124:3.4: Na kho maṃ, āvuso Kassapa, evaṃ pucchitabbaṃ:
mn124:3.5: Imehi pana te, āvuso Bakkula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevito ti?
mn124:3.6: Evañ ca kho maṃ, āvuso Kassapa, pucchitabbaṃ:
mn124:3.7: Imehi pana te, āvuso Bakkula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbā ti? Imehi pana te, āvuso Bakkula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbā ti?
mn124:3.9: Asīti me, āvuso Kassapa, vassāni pabbajitassa nābhijānāmi kāmasaññaṃ uppannapubbaṃ.
mn124:3.10: (Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti kāmasaññaṃ uppannapubbaṃ, idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhārema.)
mn124:4-5.1: Asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa nābhijānāmi byāpādasaññaṃ
mn124:4-5.3: (Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti byāpādasaññaṃ vihiṃsāsaññaṃ uppannapubbaṃ, idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhārema.)
mn124:6.1: Asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pubbajitassa nābhijānāmi kāmavitakkaṃ uppannapubbaṃ.
mn124:7-8.1: Asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pubbajitassa nābhijānāmi byāpādavitakkaṃ,
mn124:9.1: Asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa nābhijānāmi gahapaticīvaraṃ sāditā.
mn124:11-15.1: Asīti . . . nābhijānāmi sūciyā cīvaraṃ sibbitā. Yam p' . . . dhārema. Asīti . . .
mn124:11-15.3: Yam p' . . . dhārema. Asīti . . . kaṭhine cīvaraṃ sibbitā. Yam p' . . . dhārema. Asīti . . .
mn124:16-19.4: Yam p' . . . dhārema. Asīti . . . antaraghare nisīditā . . .
mn124:20-25.2: mātugāmassa dhammaṃ desitā, antamaso catuppadam pi gāthaṃ . . .
mn124:20-25.6: nābhijānami sāmaṇerāya dhammaṃ desitā. Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti sāmaṇerāya dhammaṃ desitā, idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhārema. Asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa
mn124:37.2: Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo asītiyā vassehi nābhijānāti gāmantasenāsane vassaṃ upagantā, idam pi . . . dhārema.
mn124:38.1: Sattāham eva kho ahaṃ, āvuso, sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjiṃ,
mn124:38.3: Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo sattāham eva sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñji atha aṭṭhamiyaṃ aññā udapādi, idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhārema.
mn124:39.1: Labheyyāhaṃ, āvuso Bakkula, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti.
mn124:39.2: Alattha kho AcelaKassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn124:39.3: Acirūpasampanno kho pan' āyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi;
mn124:39.4: Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn124:39.5: Aññataro kho pan' āyasmā Kassapo arahataṃ ahosi.
mn124:40.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bakkulo aparena samayena apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āha:
mn124:40.2: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto, abhikkamath' āyasmanto; ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn124:40.3: Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āha: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto, abhikkamath' āyasmanto; ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatīti, -- idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhārema. Atha kho
mn124:41.1: āyasmā Bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṃghassa nisinnako parinibbāyi.
mn124:41.2: Yam p' āyasmā Bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṃghassa nisinnako parinibbāyi, idam pi mayaṃ āyasmato Bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ dhāremāti. 125.
